description: Fork of exp706 (1.4371 @ 84.94M, <90M soft SOTA via hybrid_smooth backward). Single change: backward_mode 'hybrid_smooth' -> 'soft' (which dispatches the single-row argmax hard forward + K-row soft backward path in TinyMultiHeadLut). Loads exp706's final checkpoint as init. Restarts LR schedule (10% warmup + cosine decay to 10% of peak), runs 4000 steps. Tests: how many additional steps does the hard-forward model need to reach exp706's soft-mode bpb=1.4371? Reference data: exp687 (hard from scratch 8K) = 1.4643, never reached 1.4371; exp691 (1K hard finetune of exp684 at lr_scale=0.01) recovered ~10 mb of 34 mb. This run gives the hard model warmup+cosine + 50% of original step budget — clean test of full recovery time. NOTE: fresh optimizer state (not loading exp706's optim state) because backward gradient distribution differs (K-row soft vs 2-row hybrid_smooth).
